rationale: At the 8.59 ns floor, TD-off AREA 3 orfs runs keep +1.7-1.9 ns slack, so setup repair never engages: T_eff is natural reg-to-reg delay plus routing noise (blabla's identical netlist gave 6.62 and 6.76). Timing-driven placement cost ~0.7 ns, stock RC with slew 22 ~0.8 ns; ports no longer limit; hold, slew/cap and DRC margins are wide. Both settings keep the best recipe (R3-6: routability off, orfs, util 27, density 52%) and max electrical repair (slew 40, cap 40). Setting 2 adds post-GRT design repair to tighten slews on routed long nets. Setup margins rise to 0.4/0.3: inert at 8.59 ns, but they help the re-check at T_eff, where repair engages.
